review_note: Independent mathematical comparison with the pinned source statement transcribed as original_source_statement_tex at sites.tex:2268. Did not open any proof or raw source slice. A surjective morphism of sheaves of sets is an effective epimorphism. The two kernel-pair projection maps F×_G F⇉F and F→G coequalize to G exactly as in the original diagram, without replacing a sheaf coequalizer by an unwarranted presheaf coequalizer.
statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{F} \to \mathcal{G}$
be a surjection of sheaves of sets. Then the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
\mathcal{F} \times_\mathcal{G} \mathcal{F}
\ar@<1ex>[r] \ar@<-1ex>[r]
&
\mathcal{F} \ar[r]
&
\mathcal{G}}
$$
represents $\mathcal{G}$ as a coequalizer.
